nested_temporal_portugal.protocol: nested rolling origin; inner selection over satellite x candidate on years < outer year

paired_satellite_B1.note_on_mean: Mean count difference is dominated by the highest-activity region; use the median ratio and fold counts.
paired_satellite_B1.caveat: Folds share training years and are serially dependent; the bootstrap and sign test treat folds as exchangeable and therefore overstate precision. Descriptive only.

paired_satellite_loglinear.note_on_mean: Mean count difference is dominated by the highest-activity region; use the median ratio and fold counts.
paired_satellite_loglinear.caveat: Folds share training years and are serially dependent; the bootstrap and sign test treat folds as exchangeable and therefore overstate precision. Descriptive only.

loro_aqua.protocol: leave one region out, same calendar period; nested inner LORO for band calibration
loro_aqua.caveat: Train and test share calendar years, so this isolates geographic transfer, not temporal transfer.

loro_terra.protocol: leave one region out, same calendar period; nested inner LORO for band calibration
loro_terra.caveat: Train and test share calendar years, so this isolates geographic transfer, not temporal transfer.

rolling_band_aqua.protocol: rolling: fit < Y-1, calibrate Y-1 (12 months), score Y
rolling_band_aqua.caveat: Months within a fold share one calibration year and are dependent; coverage proportions are descriptive.

rolling_band_terra.protocol: rolling: fit < Y-1, calibrate Y-1 (12 months), score Y
rolling_band_terra.caveat: Months within a fold share one calibration year and are dependent; coverage proportions are descriptive.

T.caveat: One calibration year (12 months); small strata have very imprecise coverage estimates.

A.caveat: One calibration year (12 months); small strata have very imprecise coverage estimates.

T.interpretation: Smaller blocks give narrower intervals only because they ignore seasonal and inter-annual dependence; with four test years no unit gives a reliable interval.

A.interpretation: Smaller blocks give narrower intervals only because they ignore seasonal and inter-annual dependence; with four test years no unit gives a reliable interval.
